CustomField.description: This field is used as reference when generating new version in snapshot-evaluation-versions service. Must be unique per viewType (DMT_Type__c). When this field is set to true, automation must update all other records of the same DMT_Type__c to false. If query returns 0 rows with this flag, a full component list will be generated and stored as a version on snapshot-evaluation-versions.
CustomField.label: Is Version View
